data: Tesla reported diluted EPS of $4.30 on a GAAP basis for fiscal 2023, compared with $3.62 for fiscal 2022 (the 2022 figure is adjusted for the 3-for-1 stock split in August 2022 and is the figure shown in Tesla's 2023 10-K). That is an increase of about 18.8%. Net income attributable to common stockholders for fiscal 2023 was $14.97 billion, which included a one-time non-cash tax benefit of roughly $5.9 billion from the release of a valuation allowance on deferred tax assets. Fiscal 2022 net income was $12.56 billion, so the year-over-year rise in net income was about 19%. Excluding the tax benefit, 2023 earnings would have been noticeably lower than the headline figure, which is why non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.12 for 2023 was below the $3.40 reported for 2022.
